name: Boon of Communication

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/frhof/character-options.

summary: You influence even Hostile creatures without Disadvantage, understand any language, and speak telepathically to creatures within 120 feet.

benefits.name: Silver Tongue
benefits.summary: No Disadvantage influencing Hostile creatures; you understand any language; telepathy 120 feet.
benefits.text: When you try to influence a Hostile creature, you don't have Disadvantage. You understand the literal meaning of any spoken, signed or written language, and you can speak telepathically to a creature you can see within 120 feet. These play out in conversation: the game's conversations never give Hostile creatures Disadvantage on your checks, and every speaker understands the party.
